fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the use of the "flock" command to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.
fields.name: Shell Execution via Flock - Linux
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "/flock" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -u ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/bash" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/dash" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/fish" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/sh" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/bin/zsh")))
